_note: PROVISIONAL pending the Day-3 capture session. Same status as limits.yaml:
a change here after the first recorded episode is an experiment-version
bump (experiment_registry.md) and invalidates the episodes recorded under
the previous configuration.
MEASURED on epyc 2026-08-06, not chosen: both serials; the top camera's
available modes (v4l2-ctl --list-formats-ext) and its exposure default of
156 steps, range 10..626; the D405's advertised colour modes and its USB
link type, which negotiated 2.1 rather than 3.x.
WHY 640x480 AT 30 FPS. It is the only resolution/rate both cameras can
reach on their current links. The top camera has NO 15 fps mode in MJPG
(30 fps only; YUYV at this size caps at 25), and the D405 on USB 2.1
advertises 640x480 at 30 for colour. Recording two streams at different
rates would bake a permanent inter-camera ambiguity into every
observation, which is why load_cameras() refuses it.
WHY COLOUR ONLY FROM THE D405. 640x480 rgb8 at 30 fps is about 221 Mbps;
adding a depth stream of the same size roughly doubles that and does not
fit USB 2.1's 480 Mbps in practice. ACT consumes RGB, and
calibration_report.md permits an image-space staging fallback, so depth is
not required. If depth is ever wanted, move the D405 to a USB 3.x cable
and port FIRST, then re-record these pins.
eye_in_hand.exposure IS A PLACEHOLDER, and the one number here most likely
to be wrong. The D405's own default is 33000 us, which auto-exposure
selected for ambient light; at 30 fps the frame period is 33333 us, so
that default exposes for essentially the whole frame and would bake
maximum motion blur into every frame of a MOVING wrist camera. 8000 us is
roughly a quarter of the frame period, chosen as a starting point, NOT
measured. Day 3 sets it under actual workspace lighting.
BOTH CAMERAS CURRENTLY HAVE AUTOMATIC EXPOSURE ENABLED and the top camera
also has automatic white balance enabled (white_balance_automatic=1,
auto_exposure=3 Aperture Priority). Recording the fixed values below is
not the same as applying them: the capture code must explicitly disable
both autos, or ambient light becomes a hidden variable that drifts across
sessions and is indistinguishable from policy error afterwards. The top
camera's exposure_time_absolute reads flags=inactive until auto_exposure
is set to 1 (Manual Mode).
The D405 exposes only a 'Stereo Module' sensor, no separate RGB sensor —
its colour stream and its exposure control both live there. Exposure units
DIFFER between these two cameras: microseconds for the D405, device-defined
steps for the UVC camera. The values are recorded, never compared.
agentview/eye_in_hand names follow the sim harness idiom deliberately, so
the released prompt idiom transfers rather than being rewritten. This was
the open decision in HANDOVER.md; it is free to change until the first
episode is recorded and expensive afterwards.
